claim: The one-click demo builds a bounded, recursively redacted, HMAC-signed envelope with service, error, and first-seen fields.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /; click Try it with sample data; assert /demo, summary fields, redactions, and a 64-hex HMAC signature.

claim: Evidence is recursively redacted, limited by item and byte caps, and signed with HMAC-SHA256.
where: How it works, route builder, README
sandbox: Construct two nested evidence records with private fields and a one-item cap; assert truncation, redaction, and signature shape.

claim: Demo data never enters protected route history and the workspace expires after 24 hours.
where: Landing facts, demo banner, privacy, README
sandbox: Temporary SQLite database; create an expiring in-memory demo session, preview sample data, then assert protected history remains empty.

claim: SQLite does not retain inbound alert bodies or evidence excerpts.
sandbox: Temporary SQLite database; relay unique private markers, close the pool, and assert none occur in the database bytes.

claim: A supported provider signature is passed to the destination with the signed envelope.
sandbox: Temporary database and local capture server; relay a signed alert and assert both original and envelope signature headers arrive.

claim: Protected history returns only the latest 20 delivery metadata records.
sandbox: Temporary database; accept 25 authenticated relays and assert history returns exactly 20 rows.

claim: Route configuration, preview, history, and inbound relay traffic require separate server credentials.
sandbox: Temporary server state; send unauthenticated malformed requests to every real-data endpoint and assert 401 before parsing.

claim: The normal demo uses no analytics, advertising, third-party scripts, or hosted fonts.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; record the complete demo request log and assert every request uses the product origin.

claim: The last sample envelope reloads offline after one online demo visit.
sandbox: Dedicated fresh browser context; load /demo, wait for the service worker, switch offline, reload, and assert the sample result remains.

claim: API clients receive a 40-request burst, then 20 requests per second, keyed by the first forwarded client IP.
sandbox: Send 60 concurrent API requests from one forwarded IP; assert 429 with Retry-After 1 and an independent IP remains available.

claim: The Field Kit is a $39 USD one-time purchase through Sociobot/Dodo.
where: Landing facts, Field Kit, terms, README
sandbox: Read the rendered link; assert production and registered pilot endpoints redirect to the matching Dodo checkout hosts without making a payment.

claim: The deployment uses one application replica and mounts a durable Azure File share at /data.
test: npm run test:deployment-policy && npm run verify:live-topology
sandbox: Inspect the deployment policy locally, then query Azure and the live health endpoint for one running replica, the /data mount, and matching build identity.
